_doc: Per-query WARM convergence gate parameters for IMPL-SSOT section 3-c step 3:
'execute uncounted warmup statements until WARM convergence is PROVED, not
assumed'. The document requires convergence to be proved and the method
recorded; it names no parameter values, so they are fixed here, once, in a
checked-in file — Phase 1A runs under a deterministic driver with no LLM in
the measurement loop (section 8-b / AMEND-E), so a per-query judgment call
during the run is not available and must be made in advance.
The gate itself is warm_establish.py's: (1) the trailing window is not
monotone; (2) |half-split level drift over the whole series, burn-in dropped|
<= level_tol; (3) trailing spread <= spread_sanity. Its null distribution was
measured by the previous campaign with a moving-block bootstrap over
stationary 40-statement probes: CUBRID p95 2.68% / max 3.49% at n=20 and p95
2.16% / max 2.99% at n=40, against 13.17% for a genuinely warming series.
D1. Values are taken from the previous measurement campaign
tpch-sspq-fk-r1-20260730 where that campaign recorded one AND converged under
it (input evidence, section 1-b). For the three queries where that campaign
recorded a parameter set but FAILED to converge under it (Q05, Q06, Q07) the
tolerance is widened to level_tol 0.04 / spread 0.07 — above the measured
n=20 stationary null max of 3.49% and still 3.3x below the 13.17% warming
signal, so the gate keeps its power to reject a still-warming engine while no
longer rejecting an engine that has in fact converged. Cost: a residual level
drift of up to 4% is admitted on those three queries, which inflates their
measured block dispersion and therefore their MDE. That is the honest
direction to err — it understates what this host can resolve rather than
overstating it.
D2. Q01-Q03 predate the previous campaign's WARM stage and have no inherited
parameters; they get the harness default window 4 / level_tol 0.02 /
spread 0.05.
D3. max_statements is additionally capped so one warm phase stays near or
below ~10 minutes at the previous campaign's observed median, because the
driver runs 6 blocks x 22 queries and each block re-warms from a fresh server
start (section 6-c). The cap is a runtime bound, not a convergence claim: if
convergence is not reached within the cap the block is retried and, if it
still fails, recorded as INVALID with reason WARM_NOT_CONVERGED. It is never
silently accepted.
'inherited' records where each row came from. 'prev_median_s' is the previous
campaign's CUBRID median, used ONLY to size max_statements — section 3 forbids
reusing it as this campaign's baseline.

Q05.inherited: fk-r1 Q05 widened by D1 (fk-r1 did NOT converge at tol 0.03)

Q06.inherited: fk-r1 Q06 widened by D1 (fk-r1 did NOT converge at tol 0.02)

Q07.inherited: fk-r1 Q07 widened by D1 (fk-r1 ran only 8 statements and did NOT converge)

Q15.inherited: fk-r1 Q15 (converged after 12; unit = logical session)
